description: Registers a file a job will read. Send filename, byte size, and sha256 to get an input_id and an upload_url for a PUT of those exact bytes. A file already stored under the same SHA-256 is ready at once. For small text files, send filename and text.

content_type.description: MIME type of the bytes, for example model/gltf-binary. Optional; inferred from the filename when omitted.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen key. A retry with the same key and the same file returns the original input. A different file with the same key returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

name: add_input
title: Register an input file
